nodes.name: PaymentWebhookController.java
nodes.summary: Receives VNPay IPN webhook parameters and converts service-level webhook outcomes into VNPay response codes. It keeps gateway protocol mapping separate from PaymentWebhookService processing.

nodes.name: PaymentWebhookResult.java
nodes.summary: Defines immutable webhook processing outcomes used by the VNPay webhook flow. Static factory methods represent processed, idempotent, invalid-signature, amount-mismatch, and order-not-found results.

nodes.name: PaymentWebhookResult

nodes.summary: invalidSignature creates a named PaymentWebhookResult outcome used by webhook response handling.

nodes.name: amountMismatch
nodes.summary: amountMismatch creates a named PaymentWebhookResult outcome used by webhook response handling.

nodes.name: orderNotFound
nodes.summary: orderNotFound creates a named PaymentWebhookResult outcome used by webhook response handling.
